Many sources list what satellite data can do. This site goes one step further. How far does today's technology reach, and where does it stop? Once it is part of your operations, what can you decide with it, and where does the cost fall?

We write from the user's side, independent of any satellite operator or analytics company. The site is supervised by five people who have worked at space agencies around the world, including JAXA and ISRO.

Articles are written in Japanese. The pages listed here are available in English.

## How to read the articles

Figures and cases come with sources. Statements that have not been fully verified are listed at the end of each article. See [About](about.qmd) for how articles are produced and how sources are handled.
